description: Overrides beyond the shared truvity/ci-workflows preset. platformAutomerge stays false: a ruleset bypass keys on the actor that performs the merge, and GitHub-native auto-merge does not carry it.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A person reviews every security fix too: the shared preset turns automerge on for vulnerability alerts, and this turns it off again for this repository.

packageRules.description: Do not copy the release notes of the shared CI actions into a pull request: the notes name the repositories where a fault was seen, and the pull request body is public text that the repository's own message check scans.
A person reviews every update of a Go module or of a devbox pin (the compiler, the linter, the scanner and the other tools), so none of them is merged by itself.
These updates get a group of their own: one that needs a person must not hold back the other non-major updates, which still merge by themselves.
